scope: Exactly seven requested corrections; not a new complete audit

items.difficultyReason: Trace relationship keys, parent order and a grouped eager-loading limit against explicit rows.
items.duplicateDisposition: Per-parent Eloquent grouped limits; candidate PHP output/exception/unique-claim items share surface vocabulary, not relationship matching or partitioned SQL.

items.difficultyReason: Trace repeated callback execution and distinguish an operation-scoped value from a value recreated on each attempt.
items.duplicateDisposition: Key lifetime across Laravel transaction callback retries; unlike 0412 file compensation, 0300 lock ordering, 0271 chunk offsets or PHP0200 tenant connection scope.

items.difficultyReason: Distinguish Laravel after-commit ordering from durable intent, then analyze the independent publish/completion crash window.
items.duplicateDisposition: PHP-E26-0079 asks the generic durable-intent pattern. The revised Laravel item diagnoses afterCommit Redis dispatch and ShouldHandleEventsAfterCommit observer timing, then checks relay acknowledgment ordering. PHP-E26-0599 concerns HTTP acceptance after broker confirmation, not Laravel SQL callback/observer durability.

items.difficultyReason: Analyze one per-item commit/checkpoint boundary and distinguish scheduler exclusion from durable recovery.
items.duplicateDisposition: Recovery after partial per-item commits, unlike DST schedule occurrence 0388, chunk-memory behavior 0273, versioned cache fill 0429 or cryptographic nonce allocation PHP0579.

items.difficultyReason: Compare three partially effective designs across redirect handling, DNS timing and both address families.
items.duplicateDisposition: Combines redirects with preflight-versus-connect DNS and dual-stack enforcement. PHP0363 tests only redirect escape; PHP0173 tests parsed host equality. The revised question requires additional transport reasoning.

items.difficultyReason: Trace web-server selection before Laravel boot and distinguish file-existence, routing and execution controls.
items.duplicateDisposition: Web-server location selection before Laravel entry. Session locks, broadcasting serialization, middleware finally flow and parallel test resources are not the same execution-boundary decision.

items.difficultyReason: Coordinate mixed readers and writers, stale backfill interleavings, process draining and a later reversible cutover.
items.duplicateDisposition: Mixed-version writer authority and current-value SQL reconciliation versus stale PHP snapshots. Encryption rotation 0523, nullable PATCH presence PHP0394 and queued model rehydration 0305 concern different transitions.
